subject: Confirming invoice delivery route + VAT handling for Acme Data accounts
messages:
From: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@acmedata.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acmedata.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Billing handoff & VAT for multi-entity accounts

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the demo last week — the platform looks good. Finance asked me to confirm a couple of operational details before we finalize the PO: 

- We have two legal entities in the US and one in the UK (UK VAT applies). Can invoices be emitted per-entity with separate remit fields?
- Preferred delivery: our AP team prefers SFTP drop (encrypted) for the daily invoice bundle, but they also want a PDF copy emailed to our billing mailbox for reconciliations. Is Redwood able to both push via SFTP and send an email copy?
- Also need the billing contact verified on your side and a field for our PO number on the invoice PDF.

I'm attaching the PO draft (Acme_PO_92834.pdf). Please confirm what you need from our side to set the delivery path and VAT mapping.

Appreciate a short checklist so I can loop in AP.

Best,
Ellie
Ellie Harper
Head of Procurement, Acme Data
Attachments: Acme_PO_92834.pdf (PDF, 272 KB)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@acmedata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff & VAT for multi-entity accounts

Hi Ellie — thanks for the PO and clear questions. High level: yes, we can emit entity-level invoices and support both SFTP drops and email copies, but there are a few configuration choices to confirm. See checklist below and a couple of constraints so we align with AP security and VAT handling: 

1) Entity mapping: we need the legal entity IDs (EIN/Company reg) and remit addresses for each entity. This drives the "BillTo" block on the PDF and accounting line items.
2) VAT tagging for UK entity: if Acme is the supplier for that entity (reverse-charge scenario), we need the VAT registration and the VAT handling mode you prefer (reverse-charge statement on the invoice vs. explicit VAT line). Redwood can apply a reverse-charge note and omit VAT amount if you instruct us.
3) Delivery: we can do nightly SFTP encrypted bundles (SFTP credentials + public key from you) + an email fanout with PDF attachments to a mailbox. Email copies are limited to one internal billing mailbox per entity unless you request multiple recipients.
4) PO on PDF: we can render your PO number in the header and include it as a machine-readable field in the invoice XML payload if you consume it via API.
5) Onboarding window: to enable SFTP + per-entity routing we'll need ~5 business days after you provide the mapping and your SFTP credentials.

Action items for Acme (please reply inline):
- Provide legal-entity mapping (legal name, remit address, tax id)
- Confirm VAT handling for UK entity ("reverse-charge" or "collect VAT")
- Provide SFTP host + username + public key OR confirm you opt for email-only copies
- Confirm the billing mailbox for email copies (one address per entity)

I'll loop in Kimberly to confirm any contractual notes about data retention and our nightly bundle retention period. Once we have the mapping and creds we'll spin up the route and send a test bundle.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@acmedata.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff & VAT for multi-entity accounts

Morning Ellie — quick note from Ops/Finance side. Two clarifications: 

- Retention & access: our SFTP bundle will keep 90 days of daily invoices by default; if you need longer archival we can push to your S3 or set an extended retention SLA (extra fee).
- Encryption: we require either an RSA public key for server-side encryption or an SFTP user with pre-shared key exchange; please send the public key in a secure channel (DocuSign or provided portal key box).

Also helpful for our accounting mapping: can you confirm whether Acme uses a central AP mailbox for all entities (e.g., ap@acmedata.com) or separate mailboxes per legal entity? If central, we'll enable entity tagging in the PDF filename and in the SFTP directory path so your parser can split by entity.

Attachments: SOW-Redwood-Acme-2027.docx (proposed minimal SOW for invoicing ops)

If that works, we can provision a test drop this Thursday.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@acmedata.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff & VAT for multi-entity accounts

Thanks — yes, we can do the following and will get details by EOD Wednesday: 

- Legal-entity mapping attached in a secure spreadsheet (I'll email from secure@acme-secure.com) — includes remit addresses and tax IDs.
- UK entity: please apply reverse-charge note; Acme will not charge VAT on that entity.
- SFTP: we'll provide an SFTP host and public key; please confirm an endpoint and a test username.
- AP mailbox: central mailbox (ap@acmedata.com). Please tag filenames with entity code (ACME-US-1, ACME-US-2, ACME-UK) and include entity code in the invoice filename and the top-left header of the PDF.

One more ask — can Redwood include a short machine-readable JSON stub alongside each PDF in the SFTP bundle (invoice metadata: invoice_id, invoice_date, total, currency, entity_code, po_number)? Our parser can pick that up and reconcile faster.

Ellie

On a final note: please mark the test bundle as TEST in the filename so our parser ignores it until we've confirmed mapping.

Ellie Harper
Head of Procurement, Acme Data
